CREATE TABLE attendance_closeout_checkpoints (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	session_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	agency_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	coordinator_user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	runtime_registration_id UUID, 
	pending_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sending_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	retryable_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	needs_review_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	unreviewed_rejected_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	oldest_pending_age_seconds INTEGER, 
	reported_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_attendance_closeout_checkpoint_runtime UNIQUE (session_id, coordinator_user_id, runtime_registration_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_attendance_closeout_session_tenant FOREIGN KEY(session_id, agency_id) REFERENCES attendance_sessions (id, agency_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_attendance_closeout_runtime_tenant_coordinator FOREIGN KEY(runtime_registration_id, agency_id, coordinator_user_id) REFERENCES attendance_runtime_registrations (id, agency_id, coordinator_user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_attendance_closeout_checkpoint_nonnegative_counts CHECK (pending_count >= 0 AND sending_count >= 0 AND retryable_count >= 0 AND needs_review_count >= 0 AND unreviewed_rejected_count >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_attendance_closeout_checkpoint_oldest_pending CHECK (((pending_count + sending_count + retryable_count = 0 AND oldest_pending_age_seconds IS NULL) OR (pending_count + sending_count + retryable_count > 0 AND oldest_pending_age_seconds >= 0))), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES attendance_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(agency_id) REFERENCES agencies (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(coordinator_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(runtime_registration_id) REFERENCES attendance_runtime_registrations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE attendance_discard_tombstones (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	agency_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	group_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	session_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	coordinator_user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	runtime_registration_id UUID, 
	discard_event_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	scan_reference VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	reason_category VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	captured_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	discarded_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	received_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'accepted' NOT NULL, 
	retention_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	reconciled_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	reconciliation_note VARCHAR(500), 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_attendance_discard_event UNIQUE (agency_id, coordinator_user_id, discard_event_id), 
	CONSTRAINT fk_attendance_discard_session_tenant_group FOREIGN KEY(session_id, agency_id, group_id) REFERENCES attendance_sessions (id, agency_id, group_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT fk_attendance_discard_runtime_tenant_coordinator FOREIGN KEY(runtime_registration_id, agency_id, coordinator_user_id) REFERENCES attendance_runtime_registrations (id, agency_id, coordinator_user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_attendance_discard_scan_reference CHECK (length(scan_reference) = 64), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_attendance_discard_reason CHECK (reason_category IN ('operator_discard', 'coordinator_confirmed_rescan', 'wrong_group', 'expired_authorization', 'activity_closed', 'duplicate', 'duplicate_local_evidence', 'passenger_not_attending', 'privacy_or_data_error', 'server_rejected', 'server_terminal_rejection', 'corrupted_entry', 'other')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_attendance_discard_status CHECK (status IN ('accepted', 'reconciled', 'overridden')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_attendance_discard_time_order CHECK (received_at >= discarded_at AND retention_expires_at > received_at), 
	FOREIGN KEY(agency_id) REFERENCES agencies (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(group_id) REFERENCES client_groups (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES attendance_sessions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(coordinator_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(runtime_registration_id) REFERENCES attendance_runtime_registrations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)
